The Visionary

Mr. Vividh Chaturvedi

Founder & Chief Strategist Ex-Executive Director Sovereign Debt Specialist

"In an era of digital transience, we provide the permanence of a well-maintained ledger. True wealth isn't just about accumulation; it's about the sovereignty to decide your own future."

With over two decades of experience in institutional asset management across London, Zurich, and Dubai, Mr. Chaturvedi founded The Sovereign Ledger to bridge the gap between high-level macro strategy and individual private interests. His credentials include advising multiple sovereign wealth funds and a tenure at the helm of global risk committees.
